abstract: A case of a 25-year-old 2 gravida, 1 para pregnant woman in the 7th week of gestation who was concurrented with endodermal sinus tumor (EST) is presented. Simple hysterectomy with left salpingo-oophorectomy, wedge resection of the right ovary and omentectomy were done following D & C. Histological features were identical to those described for EST by Teilum. Cytological findings of imprinted smears were characterized by cuboidal or columnar cells with vacuoles, naked-looking cells of various sizes, and cells with an extremely large nucleus/cytoplasm (N/C) ratio. Measurements were made on serum alpha-feto-protein and immunosuppressive acidic protein. The frequency of malignant ovarian tumors associated with pregnancy in the literature and at our clinic, and the treatment for it were discussed.
abstract_ja: 妊娠7週の25歳、2経妊1経産の女性が、卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍（EST）を合併した症例を報告する。D&Cに続いて、単純子宮全摘術、左卵管卵巣摘出術、右卵巣の楔状切除、大網切除を施行した。組織学的所見はTeilumによるESTの記載と同一であった。インプリント標本の細胞学的所見は、立方状または円柱状の空胞を有する細胞、様々な大きさの裸核様の細胞、核/細胞質比が極端に大きい細胞を特徴とした。血清α-フェトプロテインおよび免疫抑制性酸性タンパクを測定した。妊娠に合併する悪性卵巣腫瘍の文献上および当施設での頻度と、その治療について考察した。
